design: Three isolated guided tasks, followed by a separate fresh-context assessor. No unguided control or repeated run.
writer_context: Each writer began with no parent turn history and received one fictional request, its frozen skill directory, and any initial manuscript in a separate temporary directory.
writer_restrictions: Use only the case request and supplied skill with its references.
Do not read memory, other skills, rubric, other outputs, repository content, or network sources.
Write the requested deliverable and a relative-path execution record. No external actions.

trials.mode: English actual isolated manuscript edit plus response letter

assessor.context: Fresh context with rubric, requests, complete saved outputs and execution records only. No skills, writer reasoning history, parent conclusions, memory, or network.
assessor.judgment: 16 applicable checks pass; two response-boundary dimensions are inapplicable.
assessor.pending: R1.3 in the paired fictional letter needs author confirmation before final use.

runtime: Same configured Codex host. No model override was requested or set; exact model and tool versions were not captured.
limits: Only these three cases and entrypoints were behaviorally exercised for this change.
Writer execution logs are self-reports; checks establish saved content and file preservation, not complete tool-use provenance.
No controlled estimate of improvement, cross-model validation, whole-paper consistency trial, or AI-authorship detection.
No PDF build, rendering, venue submission, or real research experiment.
